correctness.rationale: The 4/5 bound follows universally from Rayleigh vector (1,-1) on two nonadjacent cores, (2,-2) on attached private leaves: norm²=10 and total outgoing core transition budget ≤2, giving quotient at least 4/5. Balanced equal multipartite cores with core-edge 3/(5d) and leaf-edge 2/5 have zero core holding; their adjacency eigenvalues d,0,-m reduce P to 2×2 symmetric blocks with all nontrivial eigenvalues in [-4/5,4/5] and an attained 4/5. Equality for K_{p,q} forces Rayleigh eigenvector equality for every same-side pair: leaf weights 2/5, total core weights 3/5, equal crossing weights and hence p=q, with star case impossible by central row budget. Compactness gives strict >4/5 for unequal p,q. Independent rational block spectra tests covered balanced r,m in 2..6, but universal proof is analytic.
